about: The in-game guide on Single player (a world on the player's own PC): generated into WrathUnleashedUI/RealmGuideLocal.lua by tools/realm-guide/make_guide.py. Plain words, no brand words, only what this world has. TODO(owner): his words.
title: Single player notes
intro: Your own world on your PC, with bots and friends you invite.

pages.name: Welcome
pages.heading: Welcome to your own world
lines: This world runs on your PC: just you, the bots you bring, and friends you invite.
Experience is 2x, unless you changed it in the launcher (the Single player page, Your world).
Spells are learned for you as you level.
Bots: press Ctrl-B or click the Bots button by the minimap.

pages.name: Bots
pages.heading: Your bots
lines: Open the Bots window with Ctrl-B, the Bots button by the minimap, or /comp.
Companions follow you, fight with you and pass on loot: the loot is yours.
From the window: bring bots, pick their roles and specs, see their gear, or send them home.
Want bots to join by themselves when you log in? Turn on companions in the launcher: the Single player page, Your world.
commands: fill a 5-player group: a tank, a healer, damage
one levelling buddy at your level

pages.name: Dungeons
pages.heading: Dungeons with bots
lines: Walk into a 5-player dungeon and dungeon buddies fill your party; they go home when you leave.
Rather pick them yourself? Fill the party from the Bots window first, or recruit by role.
Raids: .recruit raid fills a 10-player raid around you.
commands: one tank (healer and dps work the same way)

pages.name: Friends
pages.heading: Play with a friend
lines: Type /together (or open Friends, the Leyline tab) and press Invite a friend: the launcher makes a link. Send it to your friend.
Your friend needs Leyline and their own game folder. No Hero Key, no account to make.
On the same network they join straight in; anywhere else, through the Leyline relay.
Their character stays in your world, theirs to keep: invite them again and it's there.

pages.name: Your world
pages.heading: Your world, on your PC
lines: Your world is saved as you play.
Leyline stops it a minute after the game closes, and when Leyline closes (both can be switched off in the launcher).
A back-up is made once a day, and before every engine update and Repair. Restore is on the launcher's Single player page.
After the first setup it plays offline. The internet is only for updates and for inviting friends through the relay.
Something wrong? Repair on the Single player page checks the engine and keeps your saves.
commands: learn every spell for your level now
